top_concerns: Method never parses or enforces query temporal constraints; time-consistency claim unsupported (edges by Hamming distance, undefined transition matrix, no time-consistency or retrieval-recall analysis)
MDL edge selection (Eqs. 5-7) is ill-specified: coverage cost sign contradicts the text, unclear when delta-L < 0, no ablation of MDL/temporal term/labeling
97% token reduction is confounded: it comes from sending top-10 events vs a heavy baseline (MedicalGraphRAG), not from the rule graph; offline cost and update cost unreported
Missing baselines: timestamp/time-window filter + dense retrieval, and published TKGQA methods; very low absolute accuracy suggests a weak protocol
No variance or significance despite 1,000-question samples; hyperparameters tuned on test; only template-based ICEWS/Wikidata benchmarks
